[head=2][color=#9c1a00]The Hadal Abyss[/color][/head]
Freedom of movement throughout Sector Crescent is constrained by a phenomenon known as the [bold]Hadal Abyss[/bold], a dense interstellar fog that disrupts conventional faster-than-light navigation and isolates systems from one another.
Its true nature remains poorly understood, even to the most dedicated and best supplied researchers.
[head=3][color=#9c1a00]The Gates[/color][/head]
To move reliably through the Abyss, massive gate structures were constructed long ago. Whether these gates were built by the Mandate or discovered already existing is unclear, and Imperial records on the matter are incomplete.
Only a handful of stable routes exist.
- One gate connects [color=#e8b04b]Taypan[/color] directly to the greater Domain. - Another leads deeper into Sector Crescent.
Because of this, Taypan naturally became the logistical heart of the entire sector, the final stable doorway before the deeper systems swallowed by the Abyss.
